description: Change some fields of one block on a page, by its id from read_page, and leave the rest of it and every other block as they are: the way to change a price, a line of text or a picture without resending the page. A block keeps its type. On a wiki, the block tools change its footer; save_wiki_page changes its articles.

fields.description: The fields to change, each replacing the one it names, an array whole; null takes a field away. Every field you leave out stays as it is.

id.description: The block's id, as read_page gives it

path.description: The page: "" for the home page, "_footer" for the footer

summary.description: What this change does, in a few words, for the history

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: update_block
title: Change a block
